newsitem.title: USA: GST names Trampush CFO, Olson president.
newsitem.headline: GST names Trampush CFO, Olson president.

text.p: GST Telecommunications Inc said it named Daniel Trampush as chief financial officer, replacing Robert Hanson, who remains senior vice president corporate development overseeing mergers and acquisitions.
Trampush has over 26 years of telecommunications industry experience, including a partnership with Ernst and Young's Telecommunications Consulting practice.

GST named Robert Olson president and chief operating officer, replacing Earl Kamsky who was named president and chief executive officer for GST Global Telecommunications Inc. Olson joined GST Telecom in 1995 as Vice President and General Manager of Exchange and Wireless services.
